page.layout: One printed page: running head with page number at top left and "ANNUS MDXXIV" heading; a list of numbered theses (8, 9, 10) in italic set indented; then running text in one column; a catchword-like marginal word "Vrstisius" in the left margin beside the paragraph starting "BASILEAE". No notes below the text.
